title.original: Organize the Web: Constructing Domains Enhances Pre-Training Data Curation
title.zh: 组织互联网：通过构建领域结构增强预训练数据筛选
title.en: Organize the Web: Constructing Domains Enhances Pre-Training Data Curation

inclusion_reason.zh: WebOrganizer 提供可复用的网页领域分类、自动标注与预训练配比控制流水线，直接补足数据基础设施的可观测与调度能力。
inclusion_reason.en: WebOrganizer supplies a reusable pipeline for web-domain taxonomy, automatic annotation, and pretraining-mixture control, directly adding observability and scheduling to data infrastructure.

abstract.zh: WebOrganizer 将网页同时按主题与页面格式组织成可解释的领域，并把大模型标注蒸馏到轻量分类器，以便在万亿 token 级语料中分析和调节预训练数据配比。
abstract.en: WebOrganizer organizes web pages along complementary topic and format taxonomies, distilling large-model annotations into efficient classifiers so that pretraining mixtures can be inspected and controlled at corpus scale.

problem.zh: 海量网页语料通常被视为一个不可解释的整体，团队难以判断其中包含什么，也难以区分“样本质量”与“领域配比”各自对模型能力的影响。
problem.en: Web-scale corpora are usually treated as opaque monoliths, making it hard to understand their contents or separate the effect of sample quality from the effect of domain composition.

approach.zh: 论文建立主题和格式两套分类体系，自动标注网页，再通过受控混合实验寻找对下游任务更有效的领域配比，并分析质量筛选方法如何隐式改变配比。
approach.en: The study builds topic and format taxonomies, automatically labels pages, runs controlled mixture experiments, and measures how quality-based selectors implicitly reshape the resulting domain distribution.

system_design.zh: 流水线由大模型标注、蒸馏后的领域分类器、全量语料注释、领域配比搜索以及与质量筛选器的组合分析构成。
system_design.en: The pipeline consists of large-model labeling, distilled domain classifiers, corpus-wide annotation, domain-mixture selection, and an analysis layer that composes mixture control with quality filters.

key_results.zh: 主题与格式配比提供了质量筛选之外的独立增益；二者结合时，下游表现优于仅按质量选择数据。
key_results.en: Topic and format mixture control provides gains beyond quality-only selection, and combining the two signals improves downstream performance over quality filtering alone.

limitations.zh: 分类体系和蒸馏分类器会继承标注模型的偏差；结论依赖所选网页快照、任务与模型规模，且不断变化的新网页领域需要重新标注。
limitations.en: The taxonomies and distilled classifiers can inherit labeling-model bias; conclusions depend on the web snapshot, tasks, and model scales studied, and emerging domains require renewed annotation.

notes.zh: 已填模型、工作负载、硬件与基线均来自官方 arXiv 摘要或 comment；摘要未给出可安全转录的结果数字，表格明细与部署配置仍待全文审计。
notes.en: Populated models, workloads, hardware, and baselines come from the official arXiv abstract or comment; the abstract provides no result number safe to transcribe, and table details plus deployment configuration still require full-text audit.
